title: King Safety
summary: Learn why king safety comes early.

steps.title: Castle early
steps.body: Castling moves the king away from the center and brings a rook toward the action. You may castle once per game, and only if the king and that rook have not moved.

steps.title: Ready to castle
steps.body: The knight and the light-squared bishop are out. The squares between the king and the h1 rook are empty.

steps.title: Castle kingside
steps.body: Move the king from e1 to g1. The rook will jump to f1.
steps.successText: The king is safer, and the rook has entered the game.
steps.errorText: Slide the king two squares toward the rook, from e1 to g1.

steps.title: When castling is illegal
steps.question: Which condition stops you from castling?

choices.label: Your king is in check and stays on an attacked square
You have already moved a pawn

steps.successText: You also cannot castle through check, out of check, or if the king or rook has moved.
steps.errorText: Pawn moves do not by themselves cancel castling. Check does.

steps.title: Lesson recap
steps.body: Castle before you attack. A king left on e1 is a target once the center opens.
